subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a durable v13 transcript-generation table and public generation-aware raw cursor API as the supported foundation for plugin transcript pagination?
rationale: This choice creates both an upgrade-visible stored-data contract and a long-lived external Plugin SDK surface; contributor validation can establish behavior, but it cannot establish the repository’s intended product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the foundation
options.body: Accept the schema v13 migration and public cursor contract, then continue review of this PR as the parent for the explicitly stacked follow-ups.

options.title: Pause for an owner decision
options.body: Do not merge until a maintainer explicitly confirms whether raw plugin cursors and durable generation state belong in the supported session contract.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Ask for an owner-local bounded-read design if maintainers do not want to support a general Plugin SDK cursor contract.

recommendation.title: Pause for an owner decision
recommendation.body: Do not merge until a maintainer explicitly confirms whether raw plugin cursors and durable generation state belong in the supported session contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned author owns the current implementation series and is the best available routing contact in the supplied context; the product decision itself still requires a repository maintainer.
